envelope.description: Make the chain report read an ISSUE-anchored definition, its story, its path and its label

body.title: Make the chain report read an ISSUE-anchored definition, its story, its path and its label
body.summary: In src/workflow/chain.ts read the definition head as a discriminated DEF-or-ISSUE value (the DEF wins when both exist). For an ISSUE head: stories holds the implied s1 from impliedIssueStories; each story path is built from the LLD's own meta (workItemAnchorCreatedAt, workItemKindOf, meta.epicSlug) so it points under docs/standalone; define reflects the ISSUE's existence, approval and rejection with its path the ISSUE document; hld is absent. ChainReport gains one optional field, definitionKind, and formatChainReport labels the definition as an ISSUE for an ISSUE head and leaves DEF output byte-identical. The existing DEF-anchored chain tests run first and must stay green. Next-action ordering is t5.
acceptanceChecks: the existing DEF-anchored chain tests (chain.test.ts, chain-report-tracker.test.ts) pass unchanged before and after the edit
an ISSUE-anchored report returns one implied story s1 with its LLD existence and approval and a path under docs/standalone, not docs/epics
when a DEF and an ISSUE share a hash the DEF is read
definitionKind is 'issue' for an ISSUE head and 'def' for a DEF head
formatChainReport shows an ISSUE label for an ISSUE head and its DEF output is byte-identical to before

tests.name: chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: chain report for an ISSUE-anchored item returns the implied s1 with its LLD state
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: chain report story path for an ISSUE-anchored item is the standalone folder
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: chain report prefers a DEF when a DEF and an ISSUE share a hash
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: definitionKind is issue for an ISSUE head and def for a DEF head
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: formatChainReport labels an ISSUE head and leaves DEF output unchanged
